## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Dutiyajananakuhana Sutta* ("Deceit and Flattery [2nd]") is the thirty-sixth discourse of the *Itivuttaka* (section 2.9, PTS It 29). The text sets forth the genuine purpose of living the holy life (*brahmacariya*), declaring that it is lived not for deceit or worldly acclaim, but for the purpose of direct knowledge and full comprehension.
